notes.title: Update V1.0d
notes.content:
Patch notes:
- Fixed bug where the skill tooltips would be tiny and unreadable
- Player no longer skips turn when trying to move into occupied space or is otherwise immobilized
- Added 'immobilized' popup when player tries to move when immobilized
- Added tip popup explaining immobilizing effects
- Fixed tip popup bug concerning duplicate tips
- tip popups can no longer appear directly above player
- fixed double sfx trigger when changing difficulty/map size

notes.title: Update V1.0c
notes.content:
Patch notes:
- Fixed AI bug crashing the game, most often occurring on easy mode
- Fixed some visual glitches of menu buttons
- Added support for non-standard monitor resolutions

notes.title: Update V1.0b
notes.content:
Patch notes:
- Changed default back-end rendering pipeline to a more modern version
- Updated underlying game engine to a more stable version
- Added rendering fallbacks for older GPU hardware
- Fixed bug where some mac users crash upon entering the options menu

This patch aims to address the random crashes some users have reported, as well as some mac specific issues.
